## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you
started.

### Install zpgarden in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure zpgarden package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to zpgarden
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/shawnemhe/zenpy-garden):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/shawnemhe/zenpy-garden.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/shawnemhe/zenpy-garden)

``` sh
$ conda install -c shawnemhe zpgarden
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/zenpy-garden/)

``` sh
$ pip install zpgarden
```

### Documentation

Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/shawnemhe/zenpy-garden)’s
[pages](https://shawnemhe.github.io/zenpy-garden/). Additionally you can
find package manager specific guidelines on
[conda](https://anaconda.org/shawnemhe/zenpy-garden) and
[pypi](https://pypi.org/project/zenpy-garden/) respectively.
